summary:
A strike on Riyadh's international airport on Saturday killed 12 people and wounded more than 300, the kingdom's deadliest strike in a decade. Saudi Arabia vowed on Sunday to retaliate against Yemen's Houthi rebels with a 'decisive' response. The Houthis have warned passengers not to use Saudi airports, and the airport will remain closed until at least Sunday night.

US President Donald Trump said on Saturday that Ukraine needs a new leader, a day after a deal with Vladimir Putin to buy large quantities of Russian diesel. Trump criticised Volodymyr Zelensky over Ukrainian strikes on Russian oil refineries, which have contributed to high diesel prices ahead of the US midterm elections. Zelensky said the deal would help Moscow fund the war, and on Sunday said Kyiv was ready to halt refinery strikes if Moscow stopped attacks on Ukrainian energy infrastructure.

President Asif Ali Zardari has put Khyber Pakhtunkhwa under emergency rule, effectively suspending its provincial government, which is run by Imran Khan's PTI party. The prime minister's office said the move followed the provincial government's 'deliberate disengagement from the fight against terrorism'. In India, police detained thousands of people in Delhi, or tens of thousands by another count, ahead of a rally over the removal of 130 million names from the electoral roll. The movement's leaders were then released, and its founder called Prime Minister Narendra Modi 'an embarrassment to India'.

headlines.title: Strike on Riyadh airport kills 12 and wounds over 300
headlines.summary: A strike on Riyadh's international airport killed 12 people and wounded more than 300 on Saturday, and the airport temporarily suspended operations. Saudi Arabia vowed a 'decisive' response against the Houthis, and the Houthis warned passengers against using Saudi airports.

headlines.title: Trump says Ukraine needs a new leader after diesel deal
headlines.summary: Trump said on Saturday that Ukraine needs a new leader, a day after a deal to buy Russian diesel. Zelensky said the deal would help Moscow fund the war, and on Sunday said Kyiv would halt refinery strikes if Moscow stopped energy attacks.

headlines.title: Pakistan imposes emergency rule in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province
headlines.summary: President Asif Ali Zardari has put Khyber Pakhtunkhwa under emergency rule, effectively suspending the provincial government led by Imran Khan's PTI party. The prime minister's office said the move followed the provincial government's 'deliberate disengagement from the fight against terrorism'.

headlines.title: India releases 'cockroach' leaders; movement calls for more protests
headlines.summary: Police detained thousands of people in Delhi, or tens of thousands by another count, ahead of a rally over the removal of 130 million names from the electoral roll. The movement's leaders were then released, and its founder called Prime Minister Narendra Modi 'an embarrassment to India'.

headlines.title: Isaias leaves four dead and power out across southern US
headlines.summary: Isaias struck Florida's panhandle late Friday as a Category 2 hurricane, then weakened to a post-tropical cyclone that has killed four people. More than 650,000 people, or about 670,000 by another count, are without power across Florida, Alabama, Georgia and Mississippi.

headlines.title: Boat capsizes off Djibouti, killing at least 109 migrants
headlines.summary: A boat carrying 350 people from Djibouti to Yemen capsized north of the town of Obock. The International Organisation for Migration said on Sunday that at least 109 migrants, including 15 children, had died and 116 were missing.

headlines.title: Abbas postpones Palestinian elections to September 2027
headlines.summary: Palestinian President Mahmoud Abbas on Saturday postponed legislative elections due next month until September 11, 2027, and called a presidential poll for the same date. He blamed Israel and the security situation in the Palestinian territories for the delay.
